error[ZBX-E0712]: can't read a state volume's record
  while  reading the record of a state volume
  cause  /home/alice/.local/share/zbx/state/pgdata/state.zon was written by a
         newer zbx
  path   /home/alice/.local/share/zbx/state/pgdata/state.zon
  fix    use the zbx that wrote it, or move the record aside (the data is not in it)
  more   zbx explain E0712
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0712.html
